description: A template library's body names enum `activity_unit`, which the library does not declare. An `enum` op resolves against the `enums` block of the file that wrote it (esm-spec §9.3), so it is lowered at the import edge against the library's block and rejected there, with a message naming the library file and the template. fixture.esm declares the enum nowhere; fixture_importer_declares.esm declares it in the importer only, which does not rescue the library (and must not silently lend it the importer's value).
